theme.description: Professional dashboard with dark sidebar and light content. Avoids purple/violet. Fresh and authoritative.

body.usage: Use for all body text, tables, and form inputs.

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 for cards and containers.
layout.bento_grid: For dashboard: md:grid-cols-3 or md:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
layout.sidebar: Fixed 250px width (or responsive), bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground. Active link gets bg-sidebar-accent and border-l-4 border-primary.

components.buttons: Rounded-md, no heavy shadows. Primary buttons use bg-primary.
components.cards: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border-border and subtle shadow-sm. Max rounded-lg.
components.tables: Clean, left-aligned headers. Use Shadcn Table component. Striped or simple bottom border.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Place forms in Modals/Sheets for adding entities.

image_urls.description: Well-lit modern dorm room, use as a 50% split hero image on the login page.
image_urls.usage: Apply a subtle bg-black/30 overlay if text is placed on it, but preferably place the login form on the solid color half.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a JWT-based custom auth system (email/password).
Implement 3 roles: admin, staff, student. The login page should have role tabs.
Sidebar navigation for Admin: Dashboard, Students, Rooms, Fees, Staff, Attendance, Complaints, Hostel Food.
Sidebar navigation for Staff: Dashboard, Students, Rooms, Attendance, Complaints, Hostel Food.
Sidebar navigation for Student: Dashboard, My Profile, My Room, My Fees, My Attendance, Complaints, Hostel Food.
Use dark sidebar (bg-sidebar) with light content area (bg-background).
Hostel Food menu must be a weekly grid (Mon-Sun x Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner) editable by Staff/Admin.
Use Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Add these fonts via Google Fonts.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
